name: OpenStreetMap locality gazetteer — bengaluru
transformation: Overpass place nodes/ways (suburb, neighbourhood, quarter, village, town, city_district, locality, hamlet) within the city bbox, deduplicated by name preferring the more specific place type
caveats: Locality-level resolution only — a locality centroid is not the property's location
